newsitem.title: CANADA: Laser Quest to place 10.715 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Laser Quest to place 10.715 mln warrants.

text.p: Laser Quest Corp said on Tuesday it agreed to issue by way of private placement 10,715,000 special warrants at a price of C$1.40 per special warrant for gross proceeds of C$15,001,000.
Laser Quest said each special warrant is exercisable for no additional consideration into one common share of Laser Quest.
The placement is slated to close by February 13, 1997.
The underwriters were granted a compensation option for a period of 18 months to receive common shares equal to 10 percent of the number of special warrants issued as part of the placement.

Laser Quest said 30 percent of the proceeds will be escrowed until clearance of a prospectus qualifying the issue of the common shares upon the exercise of the special warrants. In the event that a receipt for the prospectus is not issued within 90 days of closing, each holder of a special warrant is entitled to either a refund of 30 percent of their investment or each special warrant held will be convertible into 1.1 common shares of Laser Quest.
